name: TOOLS-GITHUB-ACTIONS-MONITOR-ANDROID
technologies: Read API v1 of GitHub Actions Monitor
notes: Preliminary release v0.1.0: the native Android client of GitHub Actions Monitor. It reads the read API v1 of a monitor with a bearer token kept sealed in the Android Keystore, shows the summary, the alerts, the repositories and the action proposals, lets a person approve or reject a proposal (the server enforces that a second person approves) and opens ghamon://proposal links. Push notifications are critical-only and OFF by default, and the Firebase side is a null implementation until a Google project exists. The rules are tested on the JVM and the release APK is built by a manual GitHub Actions workflow and signed by the maintainer; the app has not been run on a phone yet.
